# Mrugesh Beats

> Mrugesh Shukla (Mrugesh Beats) is a professional live musician, Tabla Visharad (distinction), and Music Teacher based in Nadiad, Gujarat, India. Since 2007 he has led a full live band and orchestra for weddings, destination weddings, Garba nights, Bhakti Sandhya, corporate events, and celebrity shows, and teaches Tabla, Octapad, Keyboard, and Congo at Mrugesh Beats Music Academy.

## About

- Band leader of Mrugesh Beats, a live band and orchestra offering Tabla, Keyboard, Harmonium, Octapad, Flute, Violin, and Guitar.
- Music Teacher at Delhi Public School and one-on-one/group instrument tutor.
- Founder of Mrugesh Beats Music Academy, an examination centre recognised by the Gujarat state government.
- 18+ years of live performance and teaching experience since 2007.

## Services

- Wedding Event
- Destination Weddings
- Garba Nights
- Reception
- Live Instrumental
- Celebrity Events
- Birthday Celebration
- Mehndi
- Haldi
- Bhakti Sandhya
